name: @etzhayyim/credits-kotoba
description: kotoba impl of credits (Consensys c-split). Public allocation-destination catalog + earn/spend rate reference plaintext; per-person ledger entries + allocation preference sealed via kotoba E2E (sdk.encryptedWrite/Read, ADR-2605181100); balance derived by replaying owner's own E2E ledger. The fiat merchant-of-record settlement rail (30%-fee purchase clearing) stays etzhayyim via consent-capability (ADR-2605172100: etzhayyim is never the fiat counterparty). GCC on-chain mint/treasury + key custody also etzhayyim.
